name: quadri-music-studio
description: Local YuE2-3B song studio: lyrics + style → full song, Suno style. Install with install.sh / install.bat

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node --watch backend/src/index.ts & npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
